modelAtelier.name: Futuristic Humanoid · Anatomy UV + Robot Skin
modelAtelier.reference: One continuous five-digit humanoid, 13,932 original 3D triangles. New anatomy-oriented xatlas UV charts organized by six true 3D regions. New ceramic/graphite/cyan robotic skin baked from actual local 3D positions and normals; no old atlas texture transferred. 4096px UV wireframe and 4096px anatomical UV guide are available. No rigging or geometry sculpt applied.

parts.name: Futuristic Humanoid · anatomy-mapped new robotic shell
